lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Free Ports dispatch. Another kid came into the clinic with blueglass in his coat. His delivery slip led us here. Check those crates.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Blueglass. Same blue thumbprint as the packets at the clinic. Bag a sample.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Wait. Put the lid down a second. Why does a drug shipment have a rifle rack?

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Crystal rifles. See that split sight? The gun that punched through our ferry escort had one just like it.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Three signatures on every transfer: the quartermaster who builds them, the broker who sells them, the chief who keeps it quiet. They are inside.

lines.speaker: Perrin
lines.text: Halvane used to count the till himself. Now he rings me up to ask what a moon costs.

lines.speaker: Dask
lines.text: Careful with that rack! One dent comes out of my share.

lines.speaker: Dask
lines.text: I build what I am paid to build. Ask Perrin who pays.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: One core. Two more signatures on every transfer.

lines.speaker: Rooke
lines.text: Seal it. Nobody walks out of here with a core.

lines.speaker: Perrin
lines.text: Read the receipts. The Crown took three Free Ports crossings. We got paid after every one.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Two. One more and we know all of it.

lines.speaker: Rooke
lines.text: Take it. You will not reach the lift.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: That is all three. Forget the depot: get the cores to the cargo lift. I am bringing it down.

lines.speaker: Rooke
lines.text: All posts: lock it down. They are carrying the cores.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Lift is coming. Half a minute. Do not let them pull you off it.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Here's the payment for the fourth shipment. A deed. The Crown gave Halvane the Saltmarch garrison.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: There is a recording on the last core. You should hear it.

lines.speaker: Arden (recording)
lines.text: Halvane, it's Arden. I signed for one load. You send those drivers back to their families. You gave me your word.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: ...That is Arden. That is your teacher's voice.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: Put the cores down. My drivers are still at Saltmarch. He hears one word of this and they disappear.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: You still drop your guard after the third cut. I never could fix that.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: Enough. You have grown past me.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: I drove the first rifles through myself. I thought he'd let my people go. I... I even made them sign the receipt.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Arden, give me their names. We'll take the passenger tunnel. You get there ahead of us.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Saltmarch used to be a stop on my mail run. That's Halvane's flag over the station now. His latest payment just marched in.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: A whole Crown regiment, sworn to him personally. The drivers' families are behind that lock. Get to them first.

lines.speaker: Defender
lines.text: Wardens at the lock! Hold them!

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: They stand down when they are beaten. Let them.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: You will not take one of us. Not one.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: Easy... You let my boy get back up. Who are you with?

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Free Ports. Arden sent us. We're looking for the freight drivers.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: My daughter drove the last load. Came home with a week's pay and a list of towns she'd never deliver to again.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Let me see. Oh. Those are the crossings we lost. I... I used to take her letters there.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: She's downstairs. Ring all three bells. Some of our people work nights. They'll sleep right through the shooting.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Halvane's wardens just came through the yard. I'm staying on the radio.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: They hear it. The first of them are on the stairs.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: One more, and every soul in Saltmarch is moving.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: More of them, and a marksman. Keep moving.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: That is all of them. To the chapel: the tunnel door is behind the altar.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: Hask's girl is here. She still had my receipt in her pocket. I couldn't look her in the eye.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: A hundred people are on those stairs. Hold this door with me.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: A second squad through the commons. Wardens and a marksman.

lines.speaker: Hask
lines.text: The last of us are in the tunnel. Thank you, whoever you are.

lines.speaker: Halvane
lines.text: That's my freight you're walking out with. I paid those drivers all the way through Friday.

lines.speaker: Halvane
lines.text: You know what a port costs the Crown to take? I do. I put it on the invoice.

lines.speaker: Halvane
lines.text: Captain? Get me on the shuttle. Captain... can you hear me?

lines.speaker: Halvane
lines.text: All right. My hands are open. Don't let them take me back to the Crown.

lines.speaker: Arden
lines.text: On your knees, Halvane. I'll testify about that first load. All of it. Even my signature.

lines.speaker: Ione
lines.text: Dispatch, Halvane's in custody. Impound his freighters. Hask? Your daughter's here. I'll put her on.
